name: vulcan-launcher
description: An Android home screen with Nova's depth and no internet access at all. No ads, trackers or analytics.
readme_summary: Vulcan is an Android home screen launcher designed with privacy and simplicity at its core. It offers a feature-rich experience similar to Nova Launcher but without any internet access, ads, trackers, or analytics, ensuring all data remains on the user's device.
key_features: No internet access (completely offline)
No ads, trackers, or analytics
Nova Launcher-like features (icon packs, gestures, customization)
App drawer with search and organization
Customizable look and feel (icon shapes, themes)
Backup and restore functionality
Gesture support
App shortcuts and notifications
primary_use_case: To provide Android users with a highly customizable and feature-rich home screen experience that prioritizes privacy and offline functionality.
cover_image_prompt: A minimalist, secure vault door made of warm grey metal, representing the Vulcan launcher. Instead of a lock, a single, glowing orange dot is the keyhole. On the other side of the door, a vibrant, organized city skyline made of app icons is visible, bathed in soft light. Small, subtle digital particles representing data flow are contained entirely within the vault's confines. The scene emphasizes security and contained functionality, with the vault door being the central focus. The overall style should be a clean, 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear visual metaphor and a limited, calming color palette.

name: asimov-1
description: v1 of Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot
readme_summary: Asimov 1 is an open-source, 1.2m tall, 35kg humanoid robot with 25 actuated degrees of freedom. This repository provides the necessary mechanical CAD, electrical CAD, simulation models, and onboard software for users to build, simulate, and customize their own Asimov 1 robot.
key_features: Open-source humanoid robot design
1.2m height, 35kg weight, 25 actuated DOF
Includes mechanical CAD, electrical CAD, simulation model, and onboard software
Options for DIY kit or self-sourcing components
Detailed specifications for build and performance
primary_use_case: To provide the complete set of resources (design files, software, documentation) for individuals or organizations to build, simulate, and customize their own Asimov 1 humanoid robot.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a futuristic workshop meticulously assembling a sleek, 1.2-meter tall humanoid robot. The robot is partially built, with visible internal wiring and gears, symbolizing the 'build your own' aspect. Around the artisan, holographic blueprints and schematics float, representing the CAD files and documentation. Small, glowing data streams flow from a tablet displaying code towards the robot's core, illustrating the software integration. The overall mood is one of creation and technological advancement, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear outlines and a vibrant, yet focused color palette, emphasizing the detailed components and the process of assembly.

name: aimori
description: The guardian for your AI prompts: browser extension that checks prompts for sensitive data locally before they are sent to AI sites.
readme_summary: AImori is an open-source browser extension designed to protect sensitive data when interacting with AI websites. It operates locally within the browser, scanning prompts for personal information like bank details, credit card numbers, and PII before they are sent to AI services, offering options to redact or rephrase the content.
key_features: Local data scanning: Checks prompts for sensitive data directly in the browser.
Privacy-focused: No server, no account, no telemetry, and no network access.
Broad data type detection: Identifies over 200 types of sensitive data.
Actionable options: Offers to redact, use placeholders, rephrase, or edit detected sensitive information.
Manifest V3 compatible.
Open source and free.
primary_use_case: To prevent accidental leakage of sensitive personal or organizational data into AI chat interfaces by scanning and offering to modify prompts before submission.
cover_image_prompt: A medieval knight, symbolizing AImori, stands as a vigilant guardian at the entrance to a futuristic AI chat interface. The knight holds a glowing shield that reflects and blocks sensitive data packets (represented as red, glowing icons like credit cards and bank documents) from entering the AI portal. Safe data packets (green, abstract shapes) are allowed through. Subtle digital particles and UI elements like a small 'scan complete' badge on the shield connect the metaphor to technology. The scene is set in a clean, modern digital landscape with a clear focus on the knight and the portal. Style: 3D isometric illustration with vibrant, contrasting colors and clear iconography.

name: dsh-locale-ru
description: Русская локализация DeepSeek Harness: языковой пакет, установщик .exe и сборка релизов в GitHub Actions
readme_summary: This repository provides an unofficial Russian localization package for the DeepSeek Harness application. It translates the entire user interface into Russian without modifying core application files, ensuring compatibility with future updates. The package includes an easy-to-use .exe installer and manual installation options.
key_features: Full Russian localization of DeepSeek Harness UI
Does not patch core application files (`app.asar`)
Integrates as a standard client plugin, surviving app updates
Includes a user-friendly .exe installer
Provides manual installation via PowerShell scripts
Supports automatic language switching and manual selection
primary_use_case: To provide a fully translated Russian user interface for the DeepSeek Harness application, making it more accessible to Russian-speaking users.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic Russian nesting doll (Matryoshka) gracefully opening to reveal a vibrant, fully translated user interface of the DeepSeek Harness application within its core. The outer layers of the doll are subtly etched with Russian text, while the inner interface glows with translated menus, chat windows, and settings panels. Digital particles representing language data flow from the doll's core outwards, symbolizing the translation process. The background is a clean, minimalist digital space with the repository name 'dsh-locale-ru' subtly integrated into the environment. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with bright, inviting colors and clear, readable UI elements.

name: chrome-crawler
readme_summary: Chrome Crawler is a JavaScript-based Chrome extension that acts as an AI agent within the browser's side panel. It can automate web interactions like reading pages, clicking, typing, and scrolling using the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It also supports generating scripts for routine tasks and creating 3D models via APIs.
key_features: Web page interaction (reading, clicking, typing, scrolling) via Chrome DevTools Protocol
Support for both cloud and local LLM models
User confirmation for critical actions
Automated script generation for routine tasks
Ability to read game states from page code, DOM, or canvas (pixels)
Code verification before execution (security, syntax, trial run)
3D modeling using Onshape API and FeatureScript generation
Customizable panel themes
Support for various input modalities (structure, image, combined)
Automatic updates
primary_use_case: Automating complex web interactions, generating scripts for repetitive tasks, and creating 3D models directly within the Chrome browser using an AI agent.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot assistant with glowing blue accents is perched on the edge of a giant, open Chrome browser window, looking into the screen. Below the robot, a complex web page is transforming into organized data streams and simple 3D blueprints. One stream shows product listings with prices and images flowing into a neat list, while another transforms into a rotating 3D gear. Subtle code snippets and digital particles emanate from the robot's hands, connecting the browser content to the organized outputs. The background is a soft, abstract digital landscape. The overall style is a clean, 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a futuristic, helpful mood.

name: yahont-ce
description: Self-hosted AI-платформа с расширенными возможностями: RAG, агенты, веб-поиск, исследования, коннекторы, любые LLM и гибкие настройки
readme_summary: Yahont is a self-hosted AI platform that acts as a knowledge and context layer for teams and AI agents. It connects to various data sources, indexes information, and provides answers with source citations, while also enabling LLMs with advanced capabilities like web search and image generation.
key_features: Self-hosted AI platform
Knowledge and context layer
Connects to applications and indexes data
Provides answers with source citations
Enables LLMs with web search, code execution, image generation, voice mode, and external system actions
Supports any LLM (local or cloud)
Russian interface and documentation
Based on Onyx project
primary_use_case: To provide a unified, self-hosted knowledge base and enhanced AI capabilities for teams, enabling them to leverage their internal data and external tools through AI agents and contextual search.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, ancient librarian character in a vast, organized library, holding a glowing orb that represents a team's collective knowledge. The librarian is selectively pulling threads of light from various books and digital interfaces surrounding them, weaving these threads into a coherent, illuminated scroll that is then presented to a curious AI assistant. Small, subtle UI elements showing data indexing and search queries are visible on nearby floating screens. The overall mood is one of discovery and empowerment, with a clean, slightly futuristic aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette.
